name: @prompt-compiler/mcp
description: Closed-world MCP Apps renderer for Prompt Compiler reviews.

scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run typecheck && esbuild src/stdio.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=dist/stdio.js --packages=bundle --loader:.html=text && esbuild src/create-server.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=dist/create-server.js --packages=bundle --loader:.html=text && esbuild src/review-fallback.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=dist/review-fallback.js --packages=bundle && node -e "require('node:fs').copyFileSync('public/prompt-review.html','dist/prompt-review.html')"
